PAMISARAN Sangguniang Panlalalawigan Member Province of Davao del Norte Dear SP Member Pamisaran: This concems your earlier letter requesting legal opinion on the grant of benefits to barangay officials. Your letter was endorsed by Regional Director Alex C. Roldan, DILG Regional Office Xl to the Central Office. Based on your letter the Province of Davao del Norte has an existing ordinance, Provincial Ordinance No. 2006-003, providing for hospitalization, death benefits and burial assistance to barangay officials and functionaries. You now seek to amend certain provisions of the said ordinance. In view thereof, the following queries are proffered: I. 2. 3. May the Province continue to enforce the existing ordinance and validly enact any proposed amendments thereof? Is the province authorized to allocate and release funds for all barangay appointive and elected officials who wish to avail the benefits and/or assistance as provided under existing ordinance? Is the barangay official or his/her beneficiary precluded from availing the benefits under DILG MC No. 2008-1241 when the latter already availed the benefits and assistance enumerated under our local ordinance? Anent the first query, as we understood, there appears to be two (2) issues proffered. First, whether the Sangguniang Panlalawigan may validly enact amendments to an existing ordinance, Provincial Ordinance No. 2006-003. Second, pending amendments to said existing ordinance, whether Provincial Ordinance No. 2006-003 may still be enforced. In this regard, please be informed that since the Sangguniang Panlalawigan has the power to enact ordinances and adopt resolutions, it follows that it is also authorized to amend the same taking into account the proper legislative process provided under the 1 Revised Rules and Regulations Implementing Executive Order No. 115 entitled " Authorizing Payment of Death Benefits to Barangay Officials Who Die During Their Term of Office' "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan"



Local Govemment Code of 1991 and its implementing rules and regulations. Pending amendment or until such time that the process for amendments has been completed, Provincial Ordinance No. 2006-003 is still enforceable. On the second query, we answer in the affirmative. Section 468 (a) of the Local Govemment of 1991 provides: SECTION. 468. Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. - (a) The Sangguniang Panlalawigan, as the legislative body of the province, shall enact ordinances, approve resolutions and appropriate funds for the general welfare of the province and its inhabitants.. Clearly, by allocating a portion of the local budget for financial assistance to the barangay officials in the province, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Davao del Norte acted within the powers under the Local Govemment Code. To give life to the provisions of the ordinance, the province may also allocate funds for its implementation. This must be incorporated in the appropriation ordinance or the supplemental budget, as the case may be. The number of beneficiaries that may avail of these benefits shall now be dependent on the allocated budget for the program. Thus, all may be able to avail subject to the availability of funds and compliance with the requirements prescribed by the provincial ordinance itself. Finally, as to the third query, it is opined that the availment of the benefits under the ordinance does not preclude availment of benefits under DILG MC 2008-124. Neither the DILG MC nor the existing ordinance provides prohibition in availing both benefits. Both issuances have different sources of funds and legal bases, hence, can be availed of either or both at the same time by the qualified beneficiary. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . ROMEO P. BENITEZ A Officer-in-Charge, OUSELLA ousELLA'RPB/LLLS-LRALLD,'jvpr/clp copy furnished: ALEX C. ROLDAN, CESO V Regional Director.
